plan.description: Planning agent for CI/CD pipeline design and architecture decisions

build.description: Build agent for implementing Tekton tasks, pipeline YAML, scripts, and Terraform modules

general.description: General-purpose agent for questions, troubleshooting, and infrastructure debugging

explore.description: Explore agent for navigating the codebase and finding files or references

init.template: Run ./scripts/init.sh to set up infrastructure, RBAC, PVCs, Tekton tasks, and pipeline definitions. This performs health checks, Terraform apply for Vault-to-K8s secrets, and applies all Kubernetes resources.

apply.template: Run ./scripts/apply.sh to execute the full pipeline: cleanup → clone → build → test → build-image → db-provision → db-migrate → deploy.

plan.template: Run ./scripts/plan.sh to execute a partial pipeline: cleanup → clone → build → test only (skips image build, DB provisioning, migration, and deployment).

destroy.template: Run ./scripts/destroy.sh to tear down all service-specific resources (Tekton tasks, pipelines, PVCs, RBAC, and secrets).

clean.template: Run ./scripts/clean.sh to delete PipelineRuns and TaskRuns. Options: --failed (failed only), --all (all runs), --older-than N (older than N days), --yes (skip confirmation).

health.template: Check infrastructure health: verify Kubernetes cluster, Tekton Pipelines, Vault, and container registry are all reachable.

vault-status.template: Check Vault status by running: curl -s http://localhost:8201/v1/sys/health

kubectl-pods.template: List pods in the pipeline namespace: kubectl get pods -n tekton-pipelines
